name: FramePreviewPicker
job: Let shoppers preview a print or artwork in different frame styles and sizes on a wall, scaled against a sofa-height guide
visitor_action: click frame style and size chips; the frame material crossfades and the size springs while the cast shadow stretches and settles
owner_settings: Sizes (label, width and height in cm)
mobile: chips under the preview, wall fills width
motion: frame style swaps with a quick crossfade and size animates with a spring (reduced-motion: instant swap)
art_direction: Gallery wall: soft sage plaster wall, oak, black and brass frame options, gentle raking light shadow
